summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing the closing of Sierra Madre Gold and Silver's acquisition of First Majestic's wholly-owned subsidiary that holds the Del Toro Silver Mine. Total consideration is up to US$60M, comprising US$20M cash plus 10.87M Sierra Madre shares deemed at C$1.30 per share at closing, plus a deferred US$10M cash-or-share payment due within 18 months, and up to US$30M in milestone payments tied to resource targets over 48 months. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor named. As a seller divesting a Mexican subsidiary, First Majestic receives cash and equity. Watch for Sierra Madre's operational progress and milestone triggers.
